name: Dress SparLE: Light Envisioned
game_prompt: Combat dance rhythmbattle dress-up game where Sparkle, a BlueNoMid with only a torso, floating head, hands, and feet, battles LiteMites with procedural dubstep, clothing transformations, and locked finishing poses that obliterate light-tail syncrosequences.
code_prompt: Implement a playable ActionScript 3 prototype with rhythm lanes, adaptive beat windows, procedural dubstep synthesis hooks, dress-up state changes, pose locking, light-tail enemies, visible-spectrum disruption cues, and a dynamically adaptive framebuffer-style background.
